demonstration_pools.interpretation: Two fixed replications; no population-level claim over arbitrary demonstration pools

informative_null_rule: A null is informative only when its interval excludes an absolute effect of 0.15
estimability_rule: At least two model policies yield at least 30 complete paired quartets

bootstrap.demonstration_analysis: resample base seed and treat each fixed demonstration pool as a replication

integrity_repair_rule: Any post-freeze defect requires a complete rerun of every affected confirmatory condition
